outcomes.title: You need a motor vehicle dealer licence to sell vehicles as a business
outcomes.detail: In the NT, buying, selling or exchanging motor vehicles as a business needs a motor vehicle dealer licence under the Consumer Affairs and Fair Trading Act 1990. There's no minimum number of vehicles. Lodge the NT motor vehicle dealer licence application (individual or partnership) or the NT motor vehicle dealer licence application (corporation). It costs $596 to apply, then $342 to grant (including one car yard) and $342 a year. Dealing without a licence can bring fines of up to 500 penalty units.
